This is a self-declaration of domestic manufacturing/supply; no GST turnover figure, GeM/CPPP tender award or contract record was retrieved (zaubacorp and thecompanycheck returned HTTP 403; web_search backend was down during this run), so domestic turnover = null.
note: Export side is factually confirmed by dated Indian customs records with HS codes and B/L numbers, including a 2026-02-14 shipment to Oman — so this is not a 'declared only' case. Declared HS 848190 is consistent with the observed export lines (84819090 valve/regulator parts, 84811000 pressure-reducing valves); no HS correction needed. Note the company also appears as an importer of NBR floats from SM INC (South Korea, HS 40169390, B/L 7114385 dated 2026-01-25) — i.e. it both imports components and exports finished regulators. Domestic supply: manufacturing footprint and product range are self-declared on the corporate site; GST turnover band, GeM/CPPP tenders and annual-report domestic/export splits were not publicly retrievable in this run (403s / search backend failure) — recorded as null, not estimated. No rejection grounds: entity is active, CIN published on own site.
